items.title: Victoria mode drives the strengthening of tropical Atlantic SST influence on El Niño–Southern Oscillation since the mid-20th century
items.title_en: Victoria mode drives the strengthening of tropical Atlantic SST influence on El Niño–Southern Oscillation since the mid-20th century
items.title_zh: 自20世纪中叶以来，维多利亚模式推动了热带大西洋海表温度对厄尔尼诺-南方涛动影响的增强
items.summary_en: Spring tropical North Atlantic (TNA) sea surface temperature (SST) anomalies serve as an important precursor of El Niño–Southern Oscillation (ENSO) development in the following winter. The influence of TNA SST on ENSO has strengthened significantly since the mid-20th century, yet the underlying mechanism remains unclear. Using large-ensemble simulations, AGCM experiments, and the PCMCI algorithm, we demonstrate that the North Pacific Victoria Mode (VM) is the key modulator of the recent enhancement of TNA SST influence on ENSO. Since the mid-20th century, the North Pacific climate state has shifted toward the negative VM phase, strengthening northeasterly trade winds and enhancing wind–evaporation–SST (WES) feedback over the subtropical northeastern Pacific. This background change amplifies the subtropical Pacific SST response to TNA-induced atmospheric anomalies, facilitating their subsequent extension into the tropical Pacific through WES feedback and ultimately modulate ENSO development via tropical air–sea interaction. Our results reveal that decadal variation in the North Pacific climate system substantially modulates the tropical Atlantic–ENSO teleconnection.
items.summary_zh: 春季北太平洋热带区（TNA）海表温度（SST）异常是次年冬季厄尔尼诺-南方涛动（ENSO）发展的一个重要先兆。自20世纪中叶以来，TNA海表温度对ENSO的影响显著增强，但其背后的机制尚不明确。 通过大型集合模拟、AGCM实验以及PCMCI算法，我们证明北太平洋维多利亚模态（VM）是近期TNA海表温对ENSO影响增强的关键调节因子。 自20世纪中叶以来，北太平洋气候状态已向负VM相位转变，这加强了东北信风，并增强了亚热带东北太平洋地区的风-蒸发-海表温度（WES）反馈。 这一背景变化放大了亚热带太平洋海表温度对热带大西洋-北太平洋（TNA）诱导的大气异常的响应，促使这些异常通过风-蒸发-海表温度（WES）反馈向热带太平洋延伸，并最终通过热带大气-海洋相互作用调节ENSO的发展。我们的研究结果表明，北太平洋气候系统的十年尺度变率对热带大西洋-ENSO遥相关具有显著的调节作用。

items.title: Scale-aware emergent constraints on Tibetan Plateau warming: contrasting global and regional predictors
items.title_en: Scale-aware emergent constraints on Tibetan Plateau warming: contrasting global and regional predictors
items.title_zh: 青藏高原变暖的尺度敏感型自发约束：全球与区域预测因子的对比
items.summary_en: Emergent constraints are increasingly used to reduce uncertainty in regional climate projections by exploiting relationships across models between observable historical predictors and projected changes. However, the choice of historical window and predictor scale can strongly affect constraint performance. Using the Tibetan Plateau (TP), a region of complex terrain, as a testbed, we compare two widely used predictors for constraining future TP warming: large-scale global mean surface air temperature (GSAT) and regional TP surface air temperature (TPSAT). We show that GSAT-based constraints are sensitive to the temporal evolution of external forcing and are strongest for windows beginning around 1980, consistent with the differing historical effects of greenhouse gases and aerosols. In contrast, TPSAT-based constraints generally become stronger with longer windows, indicating that extended records help suppress internal variability and better reveal the regional forced signal. At the local scale, GSAT performs better in lower-elevation regions, whereas TPSAT is more skillful over high-elevation and topographically complex areas where regional process-related signals, including cryosphere-related feedbacks, may be more important. Motivated by this spatial contrast, we develop a scale-aware constraint framework that selects the locally preferred predictor at each grid point and reduces projection uncertainty relative to either single-predictor approach over large parts of the Plateau. These findings highlight the importance of scale-aware observational constraints and may inform constrained projections in other high-elevation and topographically complex regions.
items.summary_zh: 为了利用不同模型间可观测的历史预测变量与预测变化之间的关系，从而降低区域气候预测中的不确定性，新兴约束法正被越来越广泛地应用。然而，历史时间窗口和预测变量尺度的选择会显著影响约束法的性能。 我们以地形复杂的青藏高原（TP）作为试验平台，对比了两种广泛用于约束未来青藏高原变暖的预测因子：大尺度的全球平均地表气温（GSAT）和区域性的青藏高原地表气温（TPSAT）。 我们表明，基于GSAT的约束对外部强迫的时序演变较为敏感，且在始于1980年左右的窗口内约束效果最强，这与温室气体和气溶胶在历史上的不同影响一致。 相比之下，基于 TPSAT 的约束通常随着时间窗口的延长而增强，这表明更长的观测记录有助于抑制内部变异性，并更好地揭示区域受迫信号。 在局部尺度上，GSAT 在低海拔地区表现更好，而 TPSAT 在高海拔和地形复杂的地区更有效，在这些地区，与区域过程相关的信号（包括与冰冻圈相关的反馈）可能更为重要。 受这一空间对比的启发，我们开发了一个“尺度感知”约束框架，该框架在每个网格点上选择当地最优的预测因子，并相对于两种单预测因子方法，在青藏高原的大部分地区降低了投影不确定性。 这些发现突显了尺度感知观测约束的重要性，并可能为其他高海拔和地形复杂地区的约束投影提供参考。

items.title: Deforestation footprints for jointly produced food products
items.title_en: Deforestation footprints for jointly produced food products
items.title_zh: 联合生产的食品的森林砍伐足迹
items.summary_en: Deforestation footprints rely on information on import flows. The standard procedure converts imports of semi-processed commodities into commodity equivalents. The paper distinguishes between product yields and conversion factors. It is conversion factors, which relate the commodity requirement for unit production of the semi-processed product, that are the required to estimate deforestation footprints. The simple reciprocal relationship between yields and conversion factors breaks down when there are jointly produced products such as soybean oil and meal. The paper also examines the treatment of processing waste in footprint estimation. Alternative procedures are examined and applied to the footprints of EU imports of cocoa, oil palm and soy products.
items.summary_zh: 森林砍伐足迹依赖于进口流量数据。标准流程将半成品大宗商品的进口量转换为大宗商品当量。本文区分了产品产量与转换系数。其中，转换系数反映了生产单位半成品所需的大宗商品量，这是估算森林砍伐足迹所必需的。 当存在大豆油和大豆粕等联产产品时，产量与转换系数之间的简单反比关系便不再成立。本文还探讨了在足迹估算中如何处理加工废料。研究考察了多种替代方法，并将其应用于欧盟可可、油棕和大豆产品的进口足迹估算。

items.title: Scientists discover Europe's ancient forests were nothing like we imagined
items.title_en: Scientists discover Europe's ancient forests were nothing like we imagined
items.title_zh: 科学家发现，欧洲的远古森林与我们想象的截然不同
items.summary_en: Scientists have uncovered evidence that Europe was dominated for more than 20 million years by open woodlands, colorful meadows, and large grazing animals, not the dense forests long considered its natural state. The surprising discovery challenges modern reforestation strategies, suggesting that planting thick forests could actually harm the biodiversity conservationists hope to protect.
items.summary_zh: 科学家们发现了证据，表明欧洲在超过2000万年的时间里，主要由开阔的林地、色彩斑斓的草甸和大型食草动物所占据，而非长期以来被认为是其自然状态的密林。这一令人惊讶的发现对现代造林策略提出了挑战，表明种植密林实际上可能会损害保护主义者希望保护的生物多样性。

items.summary_en: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 06 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01982-wPhotocatalytic nitrogen fixation can make ammonia from nitrogen and water under mild conditions, but slow nitrogen delivery and product build-up limit output. Now, a floating solar interface couples nitrogen reduction with evaporation, greatly speeding up ammonia formation and concentrating a high-purity product in the condensate.

items.title: Human bodies produce 2 billion metric tons of CO2 a year just by staying alive
items.title_en: Human bodies produce 2 billion metric tons of CO2 a year just by staying alive
items.title_zh: 仅靠维持生命，人体每年就会产生20亿公吨二氧化碳
items.summary_en: Humans collectively produce more than 2 billion tonnes of carbon dioxide annually just by turning food into energy, a 74% increase over three decades largely driven by population growth. Unlike fossil fuel emissions, however, the CO2 we exhale is part of the natural carbon cycle, and scientists say measuring it more accurately could improve climate models.
items.summary_zh: 仅通过将食物转化为能量这一过程，人类每年就共产生超过20亿吨的二氧化碳，这一数字在过去三十年间增长了74%，主要归因于人口增长。然而，与化石燃料排放不同，我们呼出的二氧化碳是自然碳循环的一部分，科学家表示，更准确地测量这一数据有助于改进气候模型。
